description: Encode edge, plain text: a single user turn crosses canonical chat.request -> openai/chat_completions losslessly. Synthetic, wire-accurate, hand-authored against the CompletionCreateParams struct (ocai-openai chat_completions/wire.py). The wire `model` member is NOT edge output: the canonical request carries no model (WU-05a, architecture §3.4) and the harness injects the bound resource via the codec's bind_resource seam, below the edge — ports must do the same before comparing.
